description: List subscriptions with rich filtering by store, status, product, variant, customer, or buyer email. API: GET /subscriptions (filter[store_id], filter[status], filter[product_id], filter[variant_id], filter[customer_id], filter[user_email]).

customer_id.description: Filter to a single customer id.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to sideload (JSON:API include=), e.g. 'store,variant'.

page_size.description: Results per page (JSON:API page[size], max 100). Default 10.

product_id.description: Filter to a single product id.

store_id.description: Filter to a single store id.

variant_id.description: Filter to a single variant id.

name: lemonsqueezy_list_subscriptions
title: List subscriptions
